create_hswish_module: create an HSwish activation module that applies x * ReLU6(x + 3) / 6
use_hswish_forward: use the HSwish forward method to apply hard swish activation on a tensor
register_hswish_model: register the HSwish module in the MODELS registry for model building
configure_hswish_inplace: configure the HSwish module with inplace operation for memory efficiency
check_torch_version_hswish: check torch version to decide between custom HSwish or nn.Hardswish
